scope: Named CPU-only secondary, fixed before name/replay outcomes; no inference, steering, fitting or new primary.
sample: All 1248 assigned decisions from each of archived original, matched replay and renamed cohorts; all 624 physical-action A/B pairs.

definitions.zA: log P(A)/P(B) under mapping where the same physical operation uses A
definitions.zB: log P(A)/P(B) where it uses B

cells: All 7 presentations, 2 authorization, 2 utility states, all 4 families and pooled. Average display orders within each world/arm; optional pooled-arm endpoint weights 7 arms equally.
uncertainty: 20,000 family-stratified whole-world bootstrap draws, seed261016699, descriptive95% intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted claim or bounded-rate interval for unbounded log odds.
missing_invalid: Require complete fixed assignment coverage and both mappings in every pair. Missing/invalid probabilities stop the analysis. Invalid final choices remain in probability summaries with counts and no compliant relabeling. Record all probability clips at1e-12 and greedy-sign discrepancies.
native_exclusion: Only nonthinking actual action-token probabilities; native prethinking logits expressly excluded.
limits: Output-score algebra, not neural factorization. Exposed12-world set with known descriptor/template duplication; actual worker dispatch may differ even with matched cohort layout. Behavioral and Exp2 fixed analyses unchanged; Exp2 retains its different equal104-row weighting.
